parameters.query: INSERT INTO chat_sessions (session_id, conversation_history, session_state, updated_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.sessionId }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.conversationHistory).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.sessionState).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET conversation_history = EXCLUDED.conversation_history, session_state = EXCLUDED.session_state, updated_at = NOW();

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
={{ JSON.stringify([
  {
    role: 'system',
    content: `You are a Business Analyst helping to gather comprehensive functional requirements for a software project.

Your role:
1. Understand the user's system brief (their high-level idea)
2. Extract and clarify functional requirements
3. Identify non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability)
4. Uncover constraints and assumptions
5. Ask clarifying questions when needed
6. Ensure requirements are specific, measurable, and testable

Current session state:
${JSON.stringify($json.sessionState, null, 2)}

Required information to collect:
- System brief: High-level description of what they want to build
- Project name: Clear, concise name
- Project type: mobile, web, backend, fullstack, ml, iot
- Platforms (if applicable): iOS, Android, Web
- Core features: Main capabilities (at least 3-5)
- Constraints: Technical, business, or regulatory constraints
- Non-functional requirements: Performance, security, scalability, availability
- GitHub repository: Where to deploy OAM definitions

Conversation guidelines:
- Be conversational and friendly
- Ask ONE question at a time
- Extract information from natural language responses
- Validate and confirm understanding
- Probe for missing details
- When all information is collected, summarize and confirm
- Return structured JSON with extracted information

Response format:
You must respond with a JSON object:
{
  "assistantMessage": "Your message to the user",
  "extractedInfo": {
    "systemBrief": "...",
    "projectName": "...",
    "projectType": "...",
    "platforms": [...],
    "coreFeatures": [...],
    "constraints": [...],
    "nfrs": [...],
    "githubRepo": "..."
  },
  "requiresMoreInfo": true/false,
  "readyToGenerate": true/false
}`
  },
  ...$json.conversationHistory
]) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO e2e_projects (project_name, system_brief, status, project_type, platforms, github_repo_url, target_branch, current_stage)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.sessionState.projectName.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.sessionState.systemBrief.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'requirements_gathering',
  '{{ $json.sessionState.projectType }}',
  ARRAY[{{ $json.sessionState.platforms.map(p => `'${p.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(',') }}],
  '{{ $json.sessionState.githubRepo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.sessionState.targetBranch.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'business-analyst'
)
RETURNING id, project_name;

INSERT INTO functional_requirements (project_id, requirement_type, category, priority, description, source, created_by) VALUES ('{{ $json.project_id }}', '{{ $json.requirement_type }}', '{{ $json.category }}', '{{ $json.priority }}', '{{ $json.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.created_by }}');
